items.title: OpenAI is offering $20 ChatGPT Plus for free to some users
items.description: If you're already subscribed to ChatGPT Plus, which costs $20, you can request OpenAI to cancel your subscription, and it may offer one month of free usage. [...]

items.title: The biggest cybersecurity and cyberattack stories of 2025
items.description: 2025 was a big year for cybersecurity, with cyberattacks, data breaches, threat groups reaching new notoriety levels, and, of course, zero-day flaws exploited in breaches. Some stories, though, were more impactful or popular with our readers than others. This article explores 15 of the biggest cybersecurity stories of 2025. [...]

items.title: New GlassWorm malware wave targets Macs with trojanized crypto wallets
items.description: A fourth wave of the "GlassWorm" campaign is targeting macOS developers with malicious VSCode/OpenVSX extensions that deliver trojanized versions of crypto wallet applications. [...]
